en.title: Online photos spark intrigue over purported COMAC CE-25A electric aircraft
en.summary: Photos circulating on social media purport to show a COMAC CE-25A electric aircraft demonstrator standing at an airfield, prompting discussion; the report stresses the photos have not been verified and AI generation cannot be fully ruled out.
body: Photos purporting to show a COMAC CE-25A electric aircraft demonstrator at an airfield have circulated on social media, with extensive discussion on Reddit since October 26, 2026. The report says the photos have not been verified and AI generation cannot be fully ruled out, but they look at least real; the aircraft in the photos has a red and dark fuselage marked COMAC and CE-25A, with the registration shown as B-0EFH, and its design uses over-wing ducted fans.

COMAC unveiled the CE-25A all-electric aircraft concept at the China International Import Expo in 2023, describing it as a 19-seat all-electric regional commuter aircraft with a maximum cruise speed of 400 kilometers per hour. In July 2025, COMAC announced cooperation with Chinese battery manufacturer CATL and joint research with Shanghai Jiao Tong University into new battery-powered aircraft concepts. The report does not confirm the aircraft in the photos, presenting the images as the source of intrigue about the electric aircraft's progress.

zh.title: 網傳照片引發揣測：COMAC CE-25A電動驗證機現身？
zh.summary: 社群媒體出現據稱是COMAC CE-25A電動飛機驗證機停放在機場的照片，引發討論；報導強調照片尚未獲得證實，也無法完全排除人工智慧生成影像的可能。
body: 自2026年10月26日起，社群媒體與Reddit上出現大量討論，照片據稱顯示一架COMAC CE-25A電動飛機驗證機停放在機場。報導指出，相關照片尚未獲得證實，也無法完全排除人工智慧生成影像的可能，但照片看起來至少是真實的；照片中的飛機為紅色與深色機身，機身外側有COMAC與CE-25A字樣，顯示的註冊編號為B-0EFH，設計採用翼上涵道風扇。
COMAC於2023年在中國國際進口博覽會公布CE-25A全電動飛機概念，定位為19座全電動區域通勤飛機，最高巡航速度為400公里每小時。2025年7月，COMAC宣布與中國電池製造商寧德時代合作，並與上海交通大學共同研究新型電池動力飛機概念；報導並未斷言照片中的飛機已經過證實，僅指出照片引發外界對這款電動飛機進展的揣測。
